record.dic_text:
06043 `Anayah {an-aw-yaw'}

源自 06030; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Anaiah 2; 2

亞奈雅 = "耶和華已回應"
1) 一位協助以斯拉的祭司, 他並在和尼希米所訂的公約上簽了名
record.edic_text:
06043 `Anayah {an-aw-yaw'}

from 06030;; n pr m

AV - Anaiah 2; 2

Anaiah = "Jehovah has answered"
1) a priest who helped Ezra and signed the covenant with Nehemiah
